The '''Sirilla mining station''' was a [[Mining station/Legends|mining station]] in the orbit of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Sirilla]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it got into an electron storm which destroyed the entire [[Droid/Legends|droid]] crew.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Short Sharp Shock}}</ref>
